CustomObject.description: Ledger record for each fee capitalisation event. Created by FeeCapitalisationService when a fee with Fee_Treatment = Capitalised reaches its due date. Records the notional before/after and links to the new Amortisation_Rules segment. Routes for approval before Position_Notional is updated. Spec v7 Part 5.2.8, Rule R22.
CustomObject.label: Fee Capitalisation Event
